listing.name: Dump Your Blueprints
listing.aiSummary: Lets you remove unwanted ship blueprints from your knowledge.

description: Adds an ability to discard specific ship blueprints that you have learned but no longer want. This allows players to clean up their blueprint list by removing entries they regret acquiring.
